notices.author: Oakrun Watch
notices.body: The North Road remains open, but travellers should not pass the boundary stones alone. Report strange tracks to the watch.

notices.author: Carriage Yard
notices.body: The covered carriage is being readied for longer routes. Destinations and fares will be posted here when service begins.

notices.author: Wayfarer's Rest
notices.body: Hot supper at dusk. Muddy boots by the door, blades peace-bound inside.
